verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents a large provider ecosystem: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Kubernetes and 300+ providers, with 316 packages in the Registry. Every supported language can use the full surface of all Registry providers, and users can contribute their own packages. Community users confirm managing multi-cloud (GCP and AWS) and Kubernetes resources with it in practice. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of SaaS-provider coverage beyond Cloudflare, provider freshness (one user reports Azure support lagging on deprecated APIs), and provider documentation depth (a user prefers Terraform's provider usage examples).
